# load and process data 
these data underwent this flow
OneDrive qualitative description -> cleaning function in fight_qual_clean -> .csv

```{r}
fights <- read.csv("./2_incremental/fight_qual_processed.csv")
```

# process data set 
Function to process data set by 1. creating a row for each bird in a run (adding a column for bird_id), 2. convert behaviors to binary (1 if bird performed, 0 if not)
```{r}
# Function to transform fight data from wide to long format with binary behaviors
transform_fight_data <- function(df) {
  # List of behavior columns to transform
  behavior_cols <- c("Chase", "Signal", "Face.to.face", "Spiral", 
                    "Joust", "Displace", "Retreat","Rear.approach", 
                    "Side.approach", "Win")
  
  # Function to extract bird IDs from fight string
  extract_bird_ids <- function(fight_str) {
    # Remove 'CH' or 'Ch' (case insensitive) and extract numbers
    bird_str <- gsub("(?i)ch", "", fight_str)
    birds <- unlist(strsplit(bird_str, "_"))
    birds <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", birds)
    return(birds)
  }
  
  # Create empty list to store results
  rows_list <- list()
  
  # Process each row
  for(i in 1:nrow(df)) {
    row <- df[i,]
    
    # Extract bird IDs for this fight
    bird_ids <- extract_bird_ids(row$Fight)
    
    # Create base data
    base_data <- row[c("Date", "Fight", "Run")]
    
    # Process for each bird in the fight
    for(bird in bird_ids) {
      new_row <- base_data
      new_row$bird_id <- paste0("CH", bird)
      
      # Process each behavior column
       for(col in behavior_cols) {
        if(col == "Win") {
          # Special handling for win column
          win_val <- row[["Win"]]
          if(is.na(win_val) || win_val == "") {
            new_row[[col]] <- NA #if no winner I've determined from the description, NA
          } else {
            # 1 if this bird is the winner, 0 otherwise
            winning_bird <- gsub("[^0-9]", "", win_val)
            new_row[[col]] <- as.numeric(bird == winning_bird)
          }
        } else {
          # Handle other behavior columns
          val <- row[[col]]
          if(is.na(val) || val == "") {
            new_row[[col]] <- 0
          } else {
            # Split the value if it contains multiple birds
            birds_in_val <- strsplit(gsub("[^0-9,]", "", as.character(val)), ",")[[1]]
            new_row[[col]] <- as.numeric(bird %in% birds_in_val)
          }
        }
      }
      new_row$Frontal.approach <- as.numeric(new_row$Rear.approach == 0 & new_row$Side.approach == 0)
      rows_list[[length(rows_list) + 1]] <- new_row
    }
  }
  
  # Combine all rows into a single data frame
  result <- do.call(rbind, rows_list)
  rownames(result) <- NULL
  
  return(result)
}

# Example usage:
# transformed_data <- transform_fight_data(fight_qual)
```

```{r}
fights_long <- transform_fight_data(fights)
write.csv(fights_long, "./2_incremental/fights_long.csv")
```
